messages:
maria: Heads up — after the 2743 rollout I spotted namespace-affinity rewrite behavior that allowed alias fallback across org boundaries. Rolling back now.

devon: Which part of the rewrite? any diff/PR link?

maria: PR #2743. Logic added to NamespaceRouting to fall back to aliases when primary lookup failed. It matched on `org-alias` header without scoping by `org-id`.

karen: That sounds like the bug — alias resolution must always include org-id scope. Do we have audit hits? :eyes:

maria: Yes — sample log: 
```
2026-04-12T09:12:03Z router[pid=88]: req_id=abc123 workspace_id=org-B proxied_namespace=org-A-namespace resolved_by=alias_fallback
```
Also found config snippet that triggered it:
```yaml
namespaceRouting:
  fallback:
    allowAlias: true
    matchHeaders: ["org-alias"]
```

devon: Oof. Rollback done?

maria: Rollback completed at 09:15.

sam: Immediate mitigations I recommend:
1) rollback (done)
2) invalidate routing cache across gateways
3) run an audit to enumerate cross-tenant reads last 24h
4) check KMS decrypt logs for affected key IDs (if any data-plane decrypts happened)
5) notify CS for impacted customers if PII could be exposed

maria: Ran quick audit: found 3 proxied requests from 2 distinct workspaces. At first glance it's metadata-only but need deeper pulls.

ops-oncall: Added alert rule `namespace.alias_fallback=true` and muted noisy infra alerts.

sec-bot: Automated incident created INC-2026-042. @maria assigned. Ticket includes the log snippets and initial rollback timeline.

karen: I'll open a patch PR to enforce `org-id` in alias resolution and add unit + integration tests around aliasing. Will include a migration guard to disable alias fallback by default.

sam: Also add an audit field `resolved_namespace_owner` to logs so future forensics can join on owner id directly.

maria: Follow-ups: run KMS access log queries for keys used by org-A and org-B between 09:00-09:20, confirm no decrypt events for cross-org requests, rotate keys only if decrypts found. Also block any inter-namespace egress until cleared. Details in INC card.

devon: I'll run the DB/object access query and paste result in the incident.

karen: PR opened: #2789, tests included, tagging @sam for logging changes.

maria: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene after forensics. :thumbsup:
